# lcd.drawNumber

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Draw a number with units.

```lua
lcd.drawNumber(x, y, value[, unit[, decimals[, flags]]])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | number | yes | X coordinate |
| `y` | number | yes | Y coordinate |
| `value` | number | yes | displayed value |
| `unit` | integer | optional | unit |
| `decimals` | integer | optional | number of decimals |
| `flags` | integer | optional | flags (LEFT / RIGHT / CENTERED) |

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
lcd.drawNumber(x, y, 121, UNIT_VOLT, 1, LEFT)
lcd.drawNumber(x, y, 12.121, UNIT_VOLT, 1, RIGHT)
lcd.drawNumber(x, y, 12.121, 0, 4, CENTERED)
```
